title: Hosted Payment Frame Fix

sections.name: Automatic checkout
items: Card selectors can no longer mistake a hosted payment iframe for a writable input.
Brava now discovers and fills card controls across every Electron checkout frame, including cross-origin provider frames.
Frame failures are isolated so one detached frame cannot stop checkout, and task logs include frame diagnostics if fields remain unavailable.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
